item.content:encoded:
The Five Rings Summer Internship 2027 presents an outstanding opportunity for aspiring software developers who want to gain hands-on experience in one of the world’s leading proprietary trading firms. Based in New York, this highly competitive internship combines real-world software development projects, classroom learning, mentorship from experienced engineers, and exposure to cutting-edge trading technology.

With an impressive annualized base salary of $300,000, along with a sign-on bonus and corporate housing, the Five Rings Summer Internship is among the highest-paying internship programs available for university students interested in software engineering, quantitative technology, and financial markets.

If you are passionate about programming, problem-solving, Linux systems, Python, C/C++, and building high-performance software, this internship could be your gateway into the world of quantitative trading and financial technology.

About Five Rings

Five Rings is a proprietary trading firm founded with the mission of combining technology, innovation, and strategic thinking to succeed in today’s increasingly competitive global financial markets.

The company specializes in identifying profitable opportunities across both established and niche international markets through sophisticated trading strategies and advanced technology.

Today, Five Rings operates offices in:

  • New York, USA
  • Boca Raton, Florida, USA
  • London, United Kingdom
  • Amsterdam, Netherlands

The firm promotes an open and collaborative workplace where employees are encouraged to exchange ideas across teams, helping develop innovative trading technologies and strategies.

Its success is built on a culture that values:

  • Innovation
  • Collaboration
  • Technical excellence
  • Continuous learning
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Creative problem solving

This environment provides interns with exceptional exposure to modern software engineering practices while contributing to projects that directly impact the firm’s trading operations.

About the Five Rings Summer Internship 2027

The Five Rings Summer Internship is an intensive software development internship designed for students who are interested in combining computer science with financial technology.

Rather than assigning interns minor tasks, Five Rings integrates interns directly into real software development projects that are representative of the systems used throughout the company.

Throughout the internship, participants receive:

  • Hands-on project experience
  • Technical mentorship
  • Classroom instruction
  • Software engineering training
  • Exposure to quantitative trading technology
  • Collaboration with experienced engineers
  • Insight into proprietary trading systems

Interns are expected to contribute meaningful work while simultaneously developing their technical abilities in a highly supportive environment.

What Interns Will Do

During the internship, selected candidates will participate in a combination of practical software engineering work and structured learning experiences.

Intern responsibilities include:

  • Developing production-quality software
  • Working on projects that directly support trading systems
  • Writing efficient and maintainable code
  • Collaborating with experienced software developers
  • Learning how technology powers financial markets
  • Participating in technical discussions
  • Attending educational classroom sessions
  • Solving challenging engineering problems
  • Working within Linux environments
  • Developing software using Python and C/C++

The internship emphasizes practical learning through real-world software engineering rather than simulated assignments.

Technical Skills Preferred

Five Rings seeks students with strong technical backgrounds and programming experience.

Required Skills

Applicants should have:

  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Excellent analytical thinking
  • Strong problem-solving abilities
  • Interest in software engineering
  • Passion for learning new technologies

Preferred Skills

The company also prefers candidates who have experience with:

  • C programming
  • C++ programming
  • Linux operating systems

Although experience with C/C++ and Linux is preferred, proficiency in Python is specifically listed as a requirement.

Internship Learning Experience

One of the most valuable aspects of this internship is its balance between structured education and practical engineering experience.

Interns receive classroom instruction from experienced professionals while simultaneously working on real projects.

Learning opportunities include:

  • Trading technology
  • Financial market infrastructure
  • Software architecture
  • Systems programming
  • High-performance computing
  • Software development best practices
  • Professional engineering workflows
  • Team collaboration

This combination allows interns to build both technical knowledge and industry-specific expertise.

Mentorship Opportunities

Every intern is paired with experienced software developers who provide guidance throughout the internship.

Mentors help interns:

  • Understand company technologies
  • Improve programming skills
  • Navigate engineering challenges
  • Review code
  • Develop professional software engineering habits
  • Gain exposure to real production environments

This mentorship ensures participants receive continuous support while working on meaningful technical projects.

Internship Benefits

The Five Rings Summer Internship offers an exceptional compensation package alongside valuable professional development opportunities.

Benefits include:

  • Annualized base salary of $300,000
  • Sign-on bonus
  • Corporate housing
  • Direct mentorship
  • Classroom learning
  • Real software development projects
  • Experience at a leading proprietary trading firm
  • Networking with experienced engineers
  • Exposure to financial technology
  • Professional growth opportunities

The combination of competitive compensation and meaningful work makes this one of the most attractive internship opportunities for software engineering students.

Salary and Compensation

Five Rings offers one of the highest-paying internship programs in the technology and finance sectors.

Participants receive:

  • Annual Base Salary: $300,000 (annualized)
  • Sign-on bonus
  • Corporate housing during the internship

This competitive package reflects the firm’s commitment to attracting exceptional technical talent.

Locations

The internship is based in:

  • New York, United States

Five Rings also maintains offices in:

  • Boca Raton
  • London
  • Amsterdam

Application Process

Interested applicants should complete the online application through the Five Rings Careers portal.

Applicants will generally be asked to provide:

  1. Personal information
  2. Resume or CV
  3. Educational background
  4. Academic transcript or grade report
  5. GPA information
  6. Department preference
  7. Previous work experience
  8. Information regarding competing job offers
  9. Work authorization details
  10. Privacy policy acknowledgment

Applicants may apply for multiple positions; however, Five Rings strongly encourages candidates to apply only for the role they are most interested in.

Required Application Documents

Applicants should prepare the following:

  • Resume or CV
  • Academic transcript or grade report
  • Educational information
  • GPA details
  • Employment history (if applicable)

Additional information may be requested during the online application process.

Important Dates

Interview Timeline

  • Interviews begin: September 2026

Application Deadline

  • No application deadline has been specified.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible since interviews begin in September 2026.

Why You Should Apply

The Five Rings Summer Internship provides far more than a traditional internship experience.

Participants gain:

  • Experience developing production software
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers
  • Exposure to quantitative trading technology
  • High-level technical training
  • Professional networking opportunities
  • Industry-leading compensation
  • Practical software engineering experience
  • A strong foundation for future careers in technology and finance

Whether your long-term goal is software engineering, quantitative development, systems programming, or fintech, this internship provides valuable industry experience that can significantly strengthen your career.

APPLY NOW

Conclusion

The Five Rings Summer Internship 2027 is an exceptional opportunity for university students who aspire to work at the intersection of software engineering and financial technology. Through a combination of hands-on development, structured classroom instruction, mentorship from experienced engineers, and exposure to real trading systems, interns gain invaluable technical and professional experience.

Combined with an outstanding annualized salary of $300,000, a sign-on bonus, and corporate housing, this internship stands out as one of the most competitive and rewarding programs available. Since interviews begin in September 2026 and no official application deadline has been announced, interested students should submit their applications as early as possible to maximize their chances of consideration.

Visit the OFY website for more Internship Opportunities.

item.content:encoded:
If you are a PhD student with exceptional quantitative and programming skills, the Five Rings Summer Intern 2027 – Quantitative Researcher (PhD) program offers an outstanding opportunity to gain hands-on experience at one of the world’s leading proprietary trading firms. Based in New York, this highly competitive 9-week paid internship combines cutting-edge quantitative research, real-world trading strategy development, mentorship, technical training, and professional networking.

With an annualized base salary of $300,000, plus a sign-on bonus and corporate housing, this internship is designed for talented doctoral students who are passionate about solving complex mathematical problems and applying quantitative research to financial markets.

Whether your background is in computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, physics, or another quantitative discipline, this internship provides a unique opportunity to work alongside world-class researchers and traders while gaining practical experience in quantitative finance.

About Five Rings

Five Rings is a proprietary trading firm that combines technology, quantitative research, innovation, and strategic thinking to compete successfully in global financial markets.

Founded with the goal of building sophisticated trading strategies through advanced research and technology, the firm operates offices in:

  • New York
  • Boca Raton
  • London
  • Amsterdam

The company trades across numerous domestic and international markets, continually identifying new opportunities, evaluating risks, and developing innovative strategies.

One of Five Rings’ defining characteristics is its collaborative culture. Employees are encouraged to exchange ideas freely across teams, creating an environment where innovation and continuous learning thrive.

About the Summer Internship Program

The Five Rings Quantitative Research Internship is a full-time, intensive 9-week summer program designed specifically for PhD students pursuing careers in quantitative research and algorithmic trading.

The internship runs:

  • From the beginning of June
  • Through the beginning of August

During the program, interns become integrated members of the research team and contribute directly to projects that influence real trading strategies.

Rather than simply observing professionals, interns actively participate in solving real research challenges.

What Interns Will Do

Throughout the internship, successful candidates will:

  • Work on real quantitative research projects
  • Develop mathematical models
  • Analyze financial market data
  • Collaborate with experienced quantitative researchers
  • Build research tools
  • Improve existing trading strategies
  • Explore innovative quantitative techniques
  • Solve challenging mathematical problems
  • Present ideas and findings

Interns work closely with experienced professionals who provide guidance throughout the program.

Dedicated Mentorship

One of the strongest features of the internship is its mentorship structure.

Every intern is paired with a mentor who is fully dedicated to supporting their learning and development throughout the internship.

Mentors help interns:

  • Navigate research projects
  • Improve technical skills
  • Understand trading concepts
  • Develop quantitative thinking
  • Receive continuous feedback
  • Grow professionally

This personalized mentorship allows interns to maximize their learning experience over the nine-week program.

Training and Learning Opportunities

Beyond project work, interns participate in structured educational sessions covering essential trading and quantitative finance concepts.

The program includes:

  • Classroom instruction
  • Technical lectures
  • Trading concept seminars
  • Strategy development workshops
  • In-house strategy games
  • Practical research exercises

These sessions are designed to provide a strong foundation in proprietary trading while helping interns understand how quantitative research supports financial decision-making.

Collaborative and Social Experience

Five Rings believes that strong collaboration leads to stronger innovation.

Throughout the internship, participants enjoy numerous networking and team-building activities, including:

  • Strategy game nights
  • Team dinners
  • Social events across New York
  • Networking opportunities
  • Informal discussions with experienced researchers and traders

These activities help interns build professional relationships while experiencing the firm’s collaborative culture.

Who Should Apply?

Five Rings is seeking highly talented PhD students who possess exceptional analytical ability and strong quantitative skills.

Ideal candidates should:

  • Be currently pursuing a PhD
  • Demonstrate outstanding mathematical ability
  • Enjoy solving highly complex problems
  • Think creatively
  • Learn quickly
  • Work well both independently and collaboratively
  • Be detail-oriented
  • Be proactive
  • Have strong curiosity
  • Enjoy challenging research environments

Eligible Fields of Study

Applicants should be pursuing a PhD in one of the following or a related quantitative discipline:

  • Computer Science
  • Mathematics
  • Physics
  • Statistics
  • Economics
  • Other qualifying quantitative fields

Candidates from related disciplines with strong mathematical and computational backgrounds are also encouraged to apply.

Programming Skills

Applicants should possess basic programming experience obtained through:

  • Academic research
  • Previous internships
  • University coursework
  • Research projects

Programming skills are essential since quantitative research relies heavily on computational modeling and data analysis.

Desired Qualities

Five Rings is looking for candidates who demonstrate:

  • Exceptional quantitative reasoning
  • Strong mathematical intuition
  • Analytical thinking
  • Intellectual curiosity
  • Independent problem solving
  • Team collaboration
  • Initiative
  • Precision
  • Attention to detail
  • Passion for learning

Internship Benefits

Selected interns receive a highly competitive compensation package that includes:

  • Annualized base salary of $300,000
  • Sign-on bonus
  • Corporate housing
  • Dedicated mentorship
  • Hands-on research experience
  • Professional training
  • Exposure to proprietary trading strategies
  • Networking opportunities
  • Social and team-building events
  • Classroom instruction
  • Real-world quantitative research projects

Why This Internship Stands Out

The Five Rings Quantitative Research Internship is much more than a traditional internship.

Participants receive:

  • Direct exposure to quantitative finance
  • Practical experience with real research challenges
  • One-on-one mentorship
  • Collaborative learning environment
  • Industry-leading compensation
  • Opportunities to develop advanced research skills
  • Access to experienced researchers and traders

The combination of technical learning, mentorship, and real-world application makes this one of the most prestigious internships available to PhD students interested in quantitative finance.

Salary and Compensation

Interns receive an impressive compensation package that includes:

  • Annual Base Salary: $300,000
  • Sign-on bonus
  • Corporate housing during the internship

This reflects Five Rings’ commitment to attracting outstanding quantitative talent from around the world.

Application Information

Interested candidates should prepare a strong application highlighting:

  • Academic achievements
  • Quantitative skills
  • Mathematical background
  • Programming experience
  • Research accomplishments
  • Problem-solving abilities

Candidates with demonstrated excellence in research and quantitative analysis are encouraged to apply.

Click HERE to read more and apply.

Conclusion

The Five Rings Summer Intern 2027 – Quantitative Researcher (PhD) internship is an exceptional opportunity for doctoral students who aspire to work at the intersection of mathematics, technology, and financial markets. Through challenging research projects, dedicated mentorship, technical training, and exposure to proprietary trading strategies, interns gain invaluable experience while working alongside leading quantitative researchers.

Combined with a generous compensation package—including a $300,000 annualized salary, sign-on bonus, and corporate housing—this internship represents one of the most competitive and rewarding research opportunities available for PhD students in quantitative disciplines. If you have a passion for mathematics, programming, and solving complex problems, this internship provides an excellent platform to advance your career in quantitative finance.
